correctness.rationale: The all-ordered-products relations impose U⊆K. At a fixed such flag the matrices are uniquely k maps from the t-dimensional quotient V/K to U. Exact K means the stacked linear map is injective; exact U means the images span U. With images restricted to an a-subspace A≤U the first constraint counts ordered independent t-tuples in A^k, giving the injection product. Möbius inversion in the subspace lattice gives the stated factor, and the two Gaussian coefficients count flags with dimensions r,n−t. The formula vanishes when just one dimension is zero, gives one at (0,0), and no flag is possible if r+t>n. Simultaneous transpose exchanges the image sum and common kernel by annihilators and preserves all products being zero. Radical and socle are JM and its J-annihilator because J²=0 and the quotient algebra is the field. No conjugacy quotient or characteristic condition enters. The supplied prime-field enumeration and formula-only checks were inspected, not run. A separate exhaustive binary check took all 16 matrices on F_2², formed all 256 ordered pairs, tested the four products and computed both ranks; its strata were (0,0):1 and (1,1):9. This finite check corroborates the normalization, not the general proof.
